newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Deutsche Bank launches Asian convertible bond fund.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank launches Asian convertible bond fund.

text.p: Deutsche Bank said on Tuesday it has launched a new fund geared towards growth in Asian convertible bonds.

The new fund, called DB Convert Asia, will focus on medium to long-term investors who want to profit from the high yields and above-average growth potential of Asian capital markets in Hong Kong, Thailand, Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia and Japan.

Singapore-based DB Fund Management Ltd (DBFM) will manage the fund, which will be offered at US$103 per unit by DB Investment Management SA, which is part of Deutsche Bank's investment group, Deutsche Funds Holding.
Convertible bonds offer the right to convert bonds into shares at pre-specified ratio and share price, allowing investors to exploit market conditions.
Asian convertibles now make up five percent of the global market in convertibles, growing to about US$21 billion from about US$1.6 billion in the past four years.
